about:
Oklahoma Textile LLC was founded in 2009 in Moore, Oklahoma, a suburb of Oklahoma City. The family-run business was started by Trent Dodson and Mark, who still answer customer calls directly. The company began as a commercial laundry service focused on providing medical-standard sterility for healthcare facilities in the OKC metro area.

The company operates a commercial laundry service using an advanced Ozone Laundry System that sanitizes textiles with a powerful natural oxidizer. Every customer's laundry is washed separately to eliminate cross-contamination, with bespoke wash programs tailored to each facility. Services include healthcare textiles (patient gowns, lab coats, hospital linens), mops, rags, and towels (microfiber mops, shop rags, bath and bar towels), bar and gym towels, and janitorial products (urinal cakes, air fresheners, facility essentials) delivered on the same route. The company handles pickup and delivery on flexible schedules adapted to client volume and operating hours.

Oklahoma Textile serves hospitals and health systems, clinics and medical offices, restaurants and bars, and facility and janitorial teams across the Oklahoma City metro area. Their programs are built for each industry: healthcare textiles sanitized to medical-grade standards, bar and kitchen towels kept fresh for service, and custodial closets stocked via combined laundry and janitorial deliveries.

The company differentiates itself through three core pillars: medical-standard sterility achieved via ozone sanitation, flexible scheduling with no long-term contracts or auto-renewals, and direct customer service from the founders. They emphasize no lock-in contracts, no cancellation fees, and a free cost analysis upfront.
